author_authorization: Implement parallel scheduling now alongside remaining analytical work; pause remaining work at demonstrated parallel pipeline checkpoint.

scope.preparation: One owned sample preparation; validated immutable receipt is prerequisite for downstream jobs.
scope.descriptors: Four independently owned report tasks; validate before dispatching models.
scope.models: 252 unchanged registered fits:42 MAIN and210 component. Parallelism is across fits, never by splitting observations within a fitted model.
scope.collection: Select complete independently validated attempts only; require all252 models andfour reports for final sample release.

execution.engine: Local Python scheduling of separate SAS processes; SAS analytical models remain native SAS.
execution.resource_limits_status: Conservative sample validation settings; not a full-cohort capacity certificate.
execution.scheduler_owner: One kernel queue-owner lease per batch.
execution.job_owner: One kernel lifecycle lease per logical job.
execution.shared_commit_lock: Held only for brief attempt publication and immutable selection publication.
execution.capacity: Per-batch persistent supervisor-held slots survive frontend death; global cross-batch cap not claimed.
execution.privacy: Separate worker processes and private streams; no concurrent thread-local redirection of process-global output.
execution.native_math_policy: Initialize before NumPy/SciPy imports; attest effective pools, library identities and threadpoolctl code; mutation rejects.

failure_and_restart.dispatch: On observed failure stop new dispatch; allow already running jobs to finish and retain all evidence.
failure_and_restart.retry: Fresh isolated attempt; failed attempts preserved; selected accepted attempts cannot be overwritten.
failure_and_restart.frontend_death: Independent SAS supervisor and owned payload remain identifiable and recoverable.
failure_and_restart.supervisor_death: Owned SAS job terminates; no acceptance until quiescence and durable receipts independently verified.
failure_and_restart.recovery: Resume validates selected output; does not refit an already accepted job.
failure_and_restart.preparation_change: New immutable parent and batch; no mixing of input generations.
failure_and_restart.persistent_halt: Durable failure halt; existing attempts finish, new reservations blocked until explicit acknowledgment/retry workflow.

comparison.purpose: Prove scheduling preserves scientific output on identical sample preparation, package and execution policy.
comparison.method: Schema-aware bitwise comparison of validated exported model/aggregate numeric fields and exact scientific text; row order and explicitly declared run-specific identity labels may differ.
still_required_equal: all scientific methods, category labels, plans and numerical values
comparison.status: Actual identical-package serial versus2worker: allfour reports and both representative models bitwise equal. Later final candidate4worker run separately validated; native SAS kernels unchanged.

validation_required: Actual sample representative MAIN and FULL component jobs at2workers
Complete registry collection and expected-unavailable/failure handling
Measured memory/disk/runtime before increasing workers or freezing full limits

output_rules.private_attempt_artifacts: Separate per-attempt WORK, SASUSER, logs, model/CR2/report exports, validation and runtime receipts.
output_rules.selection: Immutable receipt-bound inventory; no newest-file globbing.
output_rules.portable_decimal: Post-validation typed exact-to-decimal conversion; numeric bits and source/output hashes retained.
output_rules.publication: Private unreviewed until privacy and full release gates; no automatic dashboard publication.
